name: krish-owner-app
description: KRISH Cafe & Restaurant - Owner Mobile Application (Android & iOS) for Admin & Kitchen Panels

scripts.build:web: cd ../qr-menu-frontend && VITE_API_URL=https://cafaqr-api.p7404467.workers.dev VITE_APP_MODE=owner npm run build && rm -rf ../krish-owner-app/www && cp -R dist ../krish-owner-app/www
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.android:apk: npm run sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home" ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../KRISH-Cafe-Owner.apk
scripts.ios:open: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
